tei:div.tei:p: nga) pa la/ rgya lo tsā ba rdo rje bzang po'i yang gter la/ bla ma sku gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i zab tig mthong ba rang grol/ bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum gyi snying po zab tig mthong ba rang grol gyi spros med sgrub pa'i phrin las/ bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum gyi snying po'i don dbang bklags chog tu bkod pa bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum gyi don dbang gi zur byang rin chen phreng ba/ bla ma bstan gnyis skor gsum gyi zab tig spros med bsnyen pa'i nyams len gsal bar byed pa ye shes me long*/ rong zom lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po'i yang gter pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma rigs byed rtsal gyi man ngag khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i rtog pa/ rong zom pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i brgyud 'debs/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma rigs byed rtsal gyi bsnyen sgrub phrin las kyi byang bu dbang bskur dang bcas pa bde chen dgyes pa'i dbyangs snyan/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro rigs byed rtsal gyi bsang mchod pad+ma'i drwa ba/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro rigs byed rtsal gyi bskang ba bde chen sprin gyi rol mo/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro rigs byed rtsal gyi tshe sgrub/ rong zom pad+ma mkha' 'gro rigs byed rtsal gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga srid gsum dbang du byed pa'i lcags kyu/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro rigs byed rtsal gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi tshul mdor bsdus su bshad pa ut+pal dmar po'i phreng ba/ yar rje o rgyan gling pa'i yang gter dpal bka' 'dus kyi rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'bring po/ dpal bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsdus pa/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi phrin las nar ma rin chen snying po/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi phrin las nar ma rin chen snying po'i zur 'debs rin chen phra tshom/ dpal bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i las byang gi mchod phreng cung zad spros pa/ bka' 'dus smon lam/

bka' 'dus bkra shis/ dpal bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i las byang bde chen rnam par rol pa'i dga' ston/ dpal bka' 'dus las snying po'i nyams len rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi bka' srung mchod thabs shin tu bsdus pa/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi skong bsdus rin chen sil ma/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi snying po don gyi dbang bzhi/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi snying po don gyi thugs khrid/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi rnal 'byor rgyun gyis las sbyor/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi dbang don bdag 'jug gi cho ga ye shes bcud 'bebs/ dpal bka' 'dus las snying po don gyi dbang bzhi mtshams sbyor phyag len gyis brgyan pa rgyud lung rgya mtsho'i bcud thig /dpal bka' 'dus kyi lha dbang bkol byang*/ bka' 'dus kyi tshom bu tshogs su sgrub pa'i las tho/ bka' 'dus sgrub chen bzlas pa'i skabs su dzab bskul rgyas pa/ sgrub chen gyi gtong thun spyi khyab lha'i tam+bu ra'i dbyangs snyan/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor bkod pa/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi bsnyen bsgrub bya tshul mdor bsdus snying po rin chen do shal/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi cha lag rnal 'byor rgyun gyi las sbyor las/ rim pa gnyis pa mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa bdud rtsi sman gyi lag len ngag 'don khrigs su bsdebs pa'i rin chen snying po'i bum bzang*/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi mchog gi phrin las dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i sgrub thabs bde chen sgrub pa'i bcud len/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi tshogs sgrub sman sgrub sbrel ma'i skabs nyer mkho'i gtong thun rnam phyogs gcig tu bkod pa rin chen lha'i sil snyan/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi cha lag rnal 'byor rgyun gyi las sbyor las/ rim pa gsum pa phrin las myur du 'grub byed las bzhi'i me mchod lag len ngag 'don khrigs su bsdebs pa rin chen 'od kyi phreng ba/ dpa' bka' 'dus kyi phrin las sbyin sreg gi cho ga bde chen ye shes rab 'bar/

dpal bka' 'dus la brten pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga mdor bsdus ye shes char 'bebs/ dpal bka' 'dus kyi cha lag rnal 'byor rgyun gyi las sbyor las/ rim pa dang po bar chad bzlog pa dmar chen gtor ma'i las rim gyi lag len ngag 'don khrigs su bsdebs pa rin chen rtse mo brgya pa'i rdo rje/ bka' 'dus sman sgrub gtor zlog bcas kyi zin tho/
